residual_risks: Kellerer 1981 is a powerful directly relevant forward theorem: the stated inverse follows after exact low-order moment algebra, so independent historical priority assessment might find it implicit or published elsewhere.
Published parameter-identifiability studies using radiative pair-distance/proximity data may use different terminology and could contain an equivalent three-moment inverse.
Exact population observations do not imply stable inference from finite noisy samples.

value.rationale: This classifies exact finite-statistic recovery for the natural 2-parameter family of solid right circular cylinders: 3 moments are globally minimal, 2 yield a precisely described fold, and an exact sharp cubic separation quantifies identifiability. These distinguish inverse geometric information from known full forward distributions and provide a nontrivial motivated complete classification.
